headline: X, World Federation of Advertisers settle litigation over GARM dispute
summary: SpaceX's X and the World Federation of Advertisers (WFA) said on Wednesday they had settled litigation ‌over an alleged advertiser boycott of the social media ‌platform linked to the now-defunct Global Alliance for Responsible Media (GARM).  The move marks a ​reset in relations between Elon Musk's social media platform and the advertising trade body.  The announcement follows a March ruling in which a U.S. judge dismissed X's antitrust lawsuit accusing the WFA and ‌major companies, including Mars, ⁠CVS Health and Colgate-Palmolive of orchestrating an illegal boycott of the platform.
